stem.text: The airbags in cars contain sodium azide, $\text{NaN}_3$, and an excess of potassium nitrate, $\text{KNO}_3$.
In a car accident, the reactions shown occur, producing nitrogen. This causes the airbag to inflate rapidly.
How many moles of nitrogen gas are produced **in total** when 1 mol of sodium azide, $\text{NaN}_3$, decomposes in an airbag?
